newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Two Australians die at Israeli sporting festival.
newsitem.headline: Two Australians die at Israeli sporting festival.

text.p: The death toll from the collapse of a bridge at a Jewish sporting festival in Israel has risen to two, both of them members of the Australian team, Jewish officials said on Tuesday.

Charles Kaplan, president of the New South Wales state Maccabi or Jewish sports organisation, said the two were ten-pin bowler Greg Small, 37, and 50-year-old Yetty Bennett, section manager of the men's bowling team. Both were from Sydney.
"It's now been confirmed," Kaplan told Reuters of Bennett's death.

The two died when a bridge at Ramat Gan stadium, near Tel Aviv, collapsed as the 370-strong Australian sports contingent prepared to enter the stadium for the Maccabiah Games, nicknamed the "Jewish Olympics".
Scores of others were hurt and Kaplan said six other Australian team members were critically injured, including a 14-year-old girl swimmer.
